title: Piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x="10" y="20" width="80" height="60" rx="6" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="24" width="72" height="8" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- music stand area -->
  <rect x="28" y="34" width="44" height="18" rx="3" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <!-- three music notes on stand -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="45" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD700" transform="rotate(-20 38 45)"/>
  <line x1="40.5" y1="43" x2="40.5" y2="34" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="42" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD700" transform="rotate(-20 52 42)"/>
  <line x1="54.5" y1="40" x2="54.5" y2="31" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="46" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD700" transform="rotate(-20 62 46)"/>
  <line x1="64.5" y1="44" x2="64.5" y2="35" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- keyboard base -->
  <rect x="12" y="56" width="76" height="20" rx="3" fill="#D2B48C"/>
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x="14" y="58" width="70" height="16" rx="1" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  <!-- key separators -->
  <line x1="24" y1="58" x2="24" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="58" x2="34" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="58" x2="44" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="58" x2="54" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="58" x2="64" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="74" y1="58" x2="74" y2="74" stroke="#C4A882" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- black keys (raised, lighter dark blue for visibility) -->
  <rect x="21" y="58" width="6" height="9" rx="1" fill="#3A3A6E"/>
  <rect x="31" y="58" width="6" height="9" rx="1" fill="#3A3A6E"/>
  <rect x="46" y="58" width="6" height="9" rx="1" fill="#3A3A6E"/>
  <rect x="56" y="58" width="6" height="9" rx="1" fill="#3A3A6E"/>
  <rect x="66" y="58" width="6" height="9" rx="1" fill="#3A3A6E"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="16" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="76" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <!-- pedal base -->
  <rect x="38" y="78" width="24" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5A2D0C"/>
  <rect x="46" y="80" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#5A2D0C"/>
  <!-- decorative panel line -->
  <line x1="20" y1="52" x2="80" y2="52" stroke="#A0522D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- small bow decoration -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="1" fill="#FFC0CB"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="52" r="1" fill="#FFC0CB"/>
  <rect x="53" y="51" width="1.5" height="2" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
</svg>
